source_name: UK Prime Minister speeches on GOV.UK /government/speeches (Wayback/CDX)
leaders_covered: David Cameron; Theresa May; Boris Johnson; Liz Truss; Rishi Sunak; Keir Starmer
notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-27 (--spread --n 8): 858 captures kept, 2013-2026. GREENFIELD - the UK had no recipe (the ceremonial royal household is deliberately out of scope; the PM is the head of GOVERNMENT and the substantive speaker). TITLE(h1)/TEXT(.govspeak, 3.9k-6.4k chars)/DATE(time or .app-c-published-dates) green on every sample - clean PM material (PM address at COP26; PM press conference statement 24 May 2020; PM statement with NATO Secretary-General Stoltenberg). THE PROBLEM GOV.UK POSES: /government/speeches is the WHOLE of government - 22,696 archived captures covering ministers, ambassadors and regulators (Ofsted, CMA, UN statements) - and a speech URL carries no per-organisation segment, so the ONLY lever is the slug. GOV.UK's editorial convention prefixes the PM's items (pm-speech-, pm-statement-, pms-, prime-ministers-...), which narrows to 1,642; anchoring at $ to drop the ?utm_medium=/?mc_cid= tracking-parameter duplicates of the same speech leaves 858 canonical ones. The filter is applied BOTH server-side as a CDX original: filter (so the CDX call returns ~858 rows instead of the whole tree) and in the link_pattern. ⚠️ PRECISION OVER RECALL is deliberate and is the main thing to weigh: a PM speech whose slug lacks the prefix (e.g. 'speech-to-uk-israel-business-annual-dinner') is MISSED. Widening the pattern would flood the corpus with thousands of non-leader speeches for the cleaner to reject at cost. LEADS NOT AUTHORED: number10.gov.uk holds 165 captures of /news/speeches-and-transcripts/<yyyy>/<mm>/<slug>-<id> (Brown/Cameron 2009-2011; its <title> is clean and meta[dc.date.issued] carries an ISO date, but the body container needs a DOM pass) and 8,776 captures of the Blair-era /output/Page<N>.asp scheme, which is UNTYPED - speeches, news and biographies all share that one URL shape - so it needs its own triage before it is worth harvesting. NO speaker_default (six PMs). FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
